newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank meeting ends, no rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank meeting ends, no rate changes.

text.p: The Swedish Riksbank, the country's central bank, ended a board meeting on Thursday without announcing any changes to its key interest rates.
The bank's deposit rate was left unchanged at 4.25 percent and its lending rate at 5.75 percent.
The central bank left its key market rate unchanged at 4.60 percent in a reverse repurchase transaction announced this week.
Economists and analysts polled by Reuters expect a further cut in the repo rate and some said it could occur as early as next Thursday.
